steps.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. ONE standalone AI-original source photograph of a physical planning sheet on a pale wooden desk, portrait 3:4. Single ivory sheet, nearly front-facing overhead composition, four neatly drawn black pen rectangles arranged vertically and connected by exactly three downward arrows. Exact Simplified Chinese labels from top to bottom: 输入, 整理, 创作, 输出. Plain unbranded black pen beside sheet. Realistic daylight, paper grain and slight page curl, photographed planning document. This is the independent source input for a later tactile-model transformation. No other text, no logo, no watermark, no split layout.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Supplied planning-sheet photograph is the source of content and relationships. Follow materialized-explainer: transform its EXACT four-stage linear flow 输入 → 整理 → 创作 → 输出 into one coherent tactile physical explanatory model photographed on a real white tabletop in white studio, portrait 3:4. Four clearly separated stages arranged from back/top to front/bottom in a gentle descending sequence, connected by exactly three cobalt-blue acrylic arrow tracks, unambiguous direction. Input stage is a small stack of paper cards in matte white tray; organization stage clear acrylic sorting fins holding ordered cards; creation stage frosted acrylic chamber with a subtle blue central element; output stage refined white display plinth holding one finished paper card. Front-facing readable short black Simplified Chinese labels respectively 输入, 整理, 创作, 输出 on separate small physical white signs. One single vivid accent COBALT BLUE represents the process path only; remaining materials neutral white, pale gray, transparent and brushed metal. Real scale, contact shadows, controlled reflections and refraction, varied materials, soft studio light, clean negative space, slight high 3/4 camera. Preserve correct flow, no extra stage or feedback loop. No huge headline, marketing slogan, decorative floating blocks, neon, HUD, robots, brand or watermark. Not a diptych, deliver the transformed model image only.
